patients.summary: Healthy graphic designer in her thirties with mild adolescent scoliosis and seasonal pollen rhinitis who joins the practice in 2022. Shawl-pattern arm paresthesias in 2024 lead to a neurology referral and a cervical syrinx diagnosis in January 2025; symptoms progress by mid-2026 and neurology refers her to neurosurgery after the practice last saw her.

conditions.label: Adolescent idiopathic scoliosis
conditions.note: Mild, found at 14, never progressed; no bracing or surgery

documents.title: New Patient Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
31F transferring care; moved her primary care here after her old office stopped taking new appointments in a reasonable window. Wants a doctor she can actually reach.

No complaints today.

PMH:
- Scoliosis, mild, picked up at a school screening around 14. Followed with films as a teen, told it never progressed. No brace, no surgery. Occasional low-grade upper back stiffness after long days at the drafting table, nothing that stops her.
- Seasonal allergies, spring pollen mostly. Doesn't take anything on a schedule.
PSH: wisdom teeth out at 18.
Meds: none.
Allergies: none to medications.
FH: mother had scoliosis as a teenager. A cousin on her mother's side has a Chiari type I malformation. Father has high blood pressure. No other family history she knows of.
SH: graphic designer, mostly remote, long screen days. Never smoked. Drinks maybe once or twice a month. Lives alone, walks most evenings.
HM: last Pap with HPV testing 2020 at prior office, normal per her. Tdap a few years back. COVID primary series 2021. Will request records.

ROS negative across systems; no numbness, weakness, headaches or vision change.

Exam: vitals as recorded. Comfortable. HEENT: TMs clear, nasal mucosa pink, oropharynx clear. Neck supple, no thyroid enlargement or nodes. Heart: RRR, no murmur. Lungs: clear bilaterally. Abd: soft, nontender, no masses. Back: very slight right thoracic prominence on forward bend, no tenderness. Ext: no edema. Neuro: alert, strength and reflexes symmetric, gait normal. Skin: no rashes.

A/P:
1. Establishing care, healthy adult. Baseline labs today: CBC, CMP, lipids, TSH. Offered and she accepted one-time HIV and hepatitis C screening.
2. Scoliosis, mild, stable by history. No imaging needed.
3. Seasonal allergic rhinitis, quiet now.
4. Prior records request sent.
Flu and COVID booster when the fall supply is in; she'll book a nurse visit.

documents.title: Your lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Laura, your blood work from yesterday is all normal: blood counts, kidney and liver tests, thyroid, and cholesterol. HIV and hepatitis C screens are negative. Nothing to follow up on. Good to meet you.

documents.title: Prior primary care records
documents.author: front desk
documents.body:
Records from prior primary care office received, 23 pages. Summary for chart:
- Problem list there: scoliosis (adolescent, mild); seasonal allergic rhinitis.
- No medications on file.
- Cervical cytology with high-risk HPV co-test, March 2020: negative for intraepithelial lesion, HPV not detected. Repeat interval 5 years.
- Tdap 04/2019.
- COVID-19 Pfizer, two doses, April and May 2021.
- No allergies listed.
Immunizations entered. Routed to PCP.

documents.title: Immunization visit
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Here for seasonal flu and bivalent COVID booster. Screening questions negative, no prior reactions. Flu vaccine 0.5 mL IM left deltoid, COVID bivalent IM right deltoid. VIS given. Waited 15 minutes, felt fine, left ambulatory.

documents.title: New insurance card
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Hi, my company renewed our plan and I got new cards in the mail. Same insurer but the member ID changed. I uploaded a photo of the front and back. Thanks!

documents.title: RE: New insurance card
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Thanks Laura, got the photos and updated your coverage. You're all set.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Yearly exam. Feels well. Busy summer at work, a big rebrand project. Allergies were heavier than usual in May, settled on their own by June. Back is the same as always.

No meds. NKDA. Never smoker, rare alcohol. Sleeping fine. PHQ-2 0.

ROS: no headaches, no numbness or weakness, no bowel or bladder change, otherwise negative.

Exam: vitals as charted, BMI stays in the normal range. Well appearing. Ears and throat unremarkable. Neck without adenopathy. Heart regular, no murmur. Lungs clear throughout. Abdomen benign. Mild thoracic curve on forward bend, unchanged. No edema. Neuro grossly intact, normal gait.

A/P: Healthy 32F.
- Labs last fall were normal; nothing needed this year.
- Pap/HPV co-test due 2025.
- Scoliosis mild, stable. Rhinitis seasonal, no treatment wanted.
- Flu and updated COVID next month at a nurse visit.
RTC one year.

documents.title: Immunization visit
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Pt in for flu and 2023-24 COVID vaccine. No illness today, no reactions last year beyond a sore arm overnight. Flu IM L deltoid, COVID IM R deltoid. Observed 15 min, no issues.
